module StringTemplateDynamicNamedFormat

procedure main()
is
    let format: String = "id=${id}, active=${active}"
    let id: Integer = 7
    let active: Boolean = true
    let message: String = String.template(format, id: id, active: active)
    check message = "id=7, active=true"
end main

end StringTemplateDynamicNamedFormat
